cognitive_capacity.rationale: The items use short, concrete Grade 1 situations involving asking classmates, recording answers, and counting small totals without unnecessary abstraction or multi-step cognitive load.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every item centers on interviewing classmates, identifying the interview variable, recording responses, or counting collected responses, directly matching the stated data-collection competency.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Across the packet, learners select interview questions, identify respondents and variables, record answers, tally responses, and count results, covering the observable work required by the competency.

decomposition.reasoning: The three printed requirements separately name collecting data, using one variable, and conducting a simple interview; together they losslessly express the complete competency without adding an unrelated skill.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The samples provide coverage of initiating an interview, selecting the appropriate respondents and variable, recording answers, representing tallies, and counting category frequencies.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All quantities remain within small interview groups and familiar categories, with simple multiple-choice decisions appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 3 data work.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet varies the interview question, respondent choice, recording action, tally representation, and frequency count while preserving the same age-appropriate competency target.
